**THE FEED** · Thursday 24 September 2026

**YOUTUBE WILL NOW PUT ONE BRAND SEGMENT INTO TWENTY CREATOR VIDEOS AT ONCE, AND IT IS PAYING AGENCIES HUNDREDS OF MILLIONS TO USE IT**
Made On YouTube ran in New York yesterday.  Most of the coverage went to the artificial intelligence tools.  The part that changes what you do next quarter is smaller and duller: YouTube has built the brand deal itself into the product, in 20 countries, and it is spending hundreds of millions of dollars on incentives to agency partners to route the buying through it.

**1.** YouTube built the brand deal into its own product yesterday: Creator Partnerships in 20 countries, one brand segment insertable into 20 long-form videos at once, and hundreds of millions of dollars in incentives to agency partners.  Ask your agency in writing whether it has been offered those incentives before your next renewal.
**2.** YouTube says an in-player shopping tag gets more than twice the clicks of a link in the description, on its own product with no methodology published.  Change your creator brief template this week so tagging in the player is a contractual deliverable and the description link is the backup.
**3.** MrBeast spent 10 million dollars and eight months on a village in Ghana and predicted publicly that it would underperform, because his audience is 11 to 24 and philanthropy belongs to people three times that age.  Write the channel's audience and the subject's natural audience side by side on your next brief, and change one of them if they do not overlap.
**4.** A Rocket League semi-final peaked at 722,347 concurrent viewers, about fifty times the capacity of the arena, and Esports Charts credits community co-streams without publishing the split.  Demand that split in writing before you price an official-broadcast sponsorship.
**5.** Microdramas passed 6.5 billion views on YouTube in the first half of 2026 with television viewing up over 90 percent year on year, and Digiday reported the same day that brands cannot yet show what the format returns.  Fund one as an experiment with a write-off budget and a single agreed measure, not as a channel with a business case.
**6.** YouTube is about to let creators test three different cuts of the same video to find the best opening, after 40 million title and thumbnail experiments since 2024.  Add coverage for three distinct openings to your next call sheet as a named deliverable, because you cannot edit what nobody shot.
**7.** Creator-economy startups raised 1.39 billion dollars this month but the median round fell from 23 million dollars to 4 million, with two companies taking roughly three quarters of the total.  Negotiate a quarterly break clause and a data export right into any creator workflow vendor contract instead of a twelve-month term.
